review_candidates.company: Zero to One Search | Recruitment Agency
review_candidates.description: Mechanisms Engineer - Solar Arrays Location: Germering, on-site About the hiring company: Dcubed is a fast-growing space engineering company with the mission to make space engineering and exploration easy and accessible. What makes Dcubed special is that each of us is a space explorer at heart. At Dcubed, we enable the future of space missions with high-performance, flight-proven release mechanisms and deployable structures. From cutting-edge Release Actuators to scalable Deployable Solar Arrays and innovative Deployable Antennas, our technologies are designed for user friendliness, availability, and reliability — whether for smallsats in LEO or large missions to Moon, Mars and beyond. About the role In space, there are no second chances. As Mechanisms Engineer – Solar Arrays (f/m/d) , you will be responsible for the deployment systems at the heart of dcubed's solar arrays. You will design, prototype, test, and qualify the hardware that allows spacecraft to generate power once they reach orbit. We are looking for an engineer with a builder's mindset: someone who can move seamlessly from CAD models and FEM analyses to the workshop and test lab, turning ambitious ideas into reliable flight hardware. If you are motivated by ownership, speed, and the challenge of making space mechanisms work where repair is impossible, you'll fit right in. Responsibilities Mechanism Design & Development: Design, analyze, and develop space-qualified deployment mechanisms and motion systems for Solar Array products, from concept through flight hardware delivery. Technical Expertise: Provide expert guidance on mechanism design, materials selection, lubrication, coatings, thermal effects, motorization margins, tolerancing, and reliability for space applications. Manufacturing & Prototyping: Apply Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles, generate production-ready technical drawings, and support rapid prototyping and manufacturing activities using additive manufacturing and conventional machining techniques. System Integration: Ensure seamless integration of mechanisms with structural, electrical, and deployment subsystems while balancing performance, manufacturability, cost, and schedule requirements. Testing & Qualification: Define, support, and execute development, qualification, and acceptance test campaigns, including deployment, vibration, thermal vacuum, shock, and lifetime testing. Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement: Investigate anomalies, perform root-cause analysis, and implement design improvements to enhance mechanism performance, reliability, and manufacturability. Documentation: Maintain engineering documentation including CAD models, technical drawings, specifications, analyses, test procedures, and qualification reports. Candidate requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. 5+ years of experience in mechanism design, aerospace engineering, precision mechanical systems, or related fields. Strong knowledge of space mechanisms, including bearings, gears, springs, hinges, release systems, lubrication, coatings, wear mechanisms, thermal effects, and motorization sizing and margins. Expert-level CAD proficiency (SolidWorks preferred) and familiarity with FEM tools (ANSYS preferred). Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, GD&T, tolerancing, and technical drawing generation. Experience applying Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles. Hands-on experience with prototyping and fabrication methods including 3D printing, milling, turning, laser cutting, CNC machining, and hardware assembly. Familiarity with space qualification methods and standards, including vibration, shock, thermal vacuum, deployment, and lifetime testing. Knowledge of ECSS, NASA, or equivalent aerospace standards is highly desirable. Fluent English skills. Eligibility to work in Germany. Feel free to apply here or directly via https://dcubed.teamtailor.com/jobs/8186378-mechanisms-engineer-solar-arrays-f-m-d

review_candidates.title: Kaufmännische Profit-Center-Leitung (m/w/d)
review_candidates.description: Stellenbeschreibung: Kaufmännische Profit-Center-Leitung (m/w/d) Bochum oder Bad Wildungen Freileitungsbau Vollzeit Das Q in EQOS steht für „Quality“ und hat viele Gesichter. Eines davon ist „Erfolg“: Wir vertrauen unseren Führungskräften sowie unseren Mitarbeitenden und geben ihnen Raum zur Entwicklung. Erfolg verstehen unsere Mitarbeitenden immer als Teamleistung. #wirmögenesbesser Gemeinsam gestalten wir Netze, die unsere Gesellschaft verbinden – heute und morgen. Als Dienstleister für kritische Infrastrukturen gestalten wir die Netze der Zukunft in der Energieversorgung, der Telekommunikation und im Schienenverkehr. Wir schaffen Verbindungen, die unsere Gesellschaft am Laufen halten – zuverlässig, leistungsstark und zukunftssicher. Was uns dabei verbindet, ist ein gemeinsamer Anspruch: Qualität. Doch was Qualität bedeutet, ist individuell – bei EQOS hat jede und jeder sein persönliches „Q“. Für die einen steht es für Präzision, für andere für Teamgeist, Verlässlichkeit oder Innovationsfreude. Diese Vielfalt macht uns als Team stark – und unsere Arbeit besser. Ihre Aufgaben Steuerung: Sie steuern das Profit Center kaufmännisch und verantworten Budget, Forecast und Ergebnisplanung in der Business Unit Freileitungsbau. Controlling: Sie überwachen Kosten, Erlöse, Liquidität und Projektkennzahlen. Reporting: Sie erstellen und analysieren Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse und arbeiten eng mit den Fachabteilungen, z. B. dem Controlling, und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Kaufmännische Begleitung: Sie begleiten Angebote, Verträge, Nachträge und Claim-Management und unterstützen die operativen Führungskräfte bei Ihrer täglichen Arbeit. Führung & Optimierung: Sie führen und entwickeln die kaufmännischen MitarbeiterInnen weiter und optimieren Prozesse und Strukturen. Ihre Qualifikation Sie verfügen über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. der Fachrichtung Betriebs­wirtschaftslehre / Wirtschaftswissenschaften / Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder ähnlich. Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren kaufmännischen Managementfunktion sowie Erfahrung im Projektgeschäft mit. Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse im Controlling, Rechnungswesen und Projektmanagement sowie idealerweise Erfahrung im Infrastruktur-, Energie-, Bau- oder Anlagenumfeld. Sie sind sicher im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen und MS Office, insbesondere Excel, und verfügen über Reisebereitschaft sowie einen Führerschein der Klasse B. Sie schaffen mit Ihrer Kommunikations- und Durchsetzungsstärke die Basis für eine erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung. Ihre Vorteile Firmenwagen Sie erhalten einen Firmenwagen, den Sie auch privat nutzen können. Gestaltungsspielraum & Verantwortung Bei uns übernehmen Sie Verantwortung und gestalten Projekte aktiv mit. Unbefristeter Vertrag Wir geben Ihnen Sicherheit: Vom ersten Tag an starten Sie mit einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag. Bike-Leasing Nutzen Sie unser attraktives Angebot zum Leasing hochwertiger Fahrräder – umweltfreundlich und flexibel. Flexible Arbeitszeiten Wir bieten Ihnen mobile Arbeitsmöglichkeiten und Flexibilität. Noch Fragen offen? Jetzt bewerben! Alles rund um unseren Bewerbungsprozess und die FAQs finden Sie unter jobs.eqos-gruppe.com/Jobs#faqs. Wenn Sie Fragen zur Position haben oder etwas im Bewerbungsprozess unklar ist, helfen wir Ihnen gerne weiter. review_candidates.description: About Us: eMoldino is a pioneering global leader in enterprise-level supply chain management (SCM) solutions with secured investments from top VCs. eMoldino is driving digital transformation for Fortune 500 companies and major manufacturing organizations worldwide such as Tesla, Jaguar Land Rover, P&G and Dyson. We are in an exciting phase of rapid expansion, at the forefront of global solution delivery in one of the most innovative sectors, collaborating directly with our Silicon Valley based board director with AUM of 60 billion, various senior executives for global hegemonic clients, domestic and global VCs, and other business partners across the US, EU, and Asia.  Position Overview: As an IoT Field Service Engineer, you will be responsible for deploying IT infrastructures and servicing hardware across multiple manufacturing industries for global OEMs. The immediate service area for this position is Puerto Rico, however, you will also be part of a larger team that is responsible for technical deployment and maintenance across North America. All product training will be provided by eMoldino, however, only technically qualified applicants will be considered for this position.  Responsibilities: Deployment & Implementation: Installation and configuration of sensors, terminals, and related hardware, ensuring successful deployment in manufacturing environments. Aptitude for work-related travel is mandatory as projects can last up to 3-5 weeks across North America. Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Provide on-site or remote technical support to site personnel, particularly in the North American market, diagnosing and resolving hardware issues efficiently. Data Administration: Clean, import, and harmonize OEM tooling data, ensuring accuracy and consistency. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Liaise between the site personnel, Implementation, and Sales teams to ensure alignment and seamless communication. Continuous Improvement: Gather feedback from the field to help improve deployment processes. Qualifications: Education: A bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or a technical certification and/or a polytechnic degree.  Experience: Relevant field service or hardware installation experience in industries such as telecommunications, IoT, energy, manufacturing, or automotive is also valued. Language(s):  Spanish (Native Speaker or C2-level) The language of the site personnel. English (Native Speaker or C1-level) The working language of the company and our clients.  Technical Aptitude: Highly proficient in technical procedures, such as troubleshooting, diagnostic testing, and database management.  Management Tools: Knowledge of program script writing (python, google apps, etc.), 3D modeling or design applications is highly valued.  Aptitude: Physically capable of working on-site in a manufacturing environment and installing the IoT product (including site management and alignment with site personnel). Duration :  This is a 12 month contract offer in which the first 90 days will be a training and probationary period.

review_candidates.title: Integration Lead
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Team Lead - Integration Development Job Grade: 5 Reference Code: REF-IT-IDTL-022025 Department/Group: IT Location: Remote/Onsite Working Hours: 40 hours per week Line Manager: Global Head of Engineering Job Purpose: The Team Lead - Integration Development is responsible for overseeing the design, development, and maintenance of integration solutions that ensure seamless data exchange between Mercans’ payroll software and third-party systems such as Human Capital Management (HCM), Workforce Management (WFM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), accounting platforms, tax compliance systems, and benefits providers. This role combines technical expertise with leadership responsibilities, ensuring the team delivers scalable, secure, and efficient integrations that align with business objectives and compliance requirements. Duties and responsibilities: Team Leadership and Management Lead, mentor, and manage the Integration Development team, ensuring optimal performance and continuous professional growth. Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technology roadmaps. Allocate tasks and resources efficiently, balancing project priorities, sprint planning, and business-critical integrations. Conduct regular one-on-one meetings and performance reviews, setting clear goals for team members and supporting their career development. Encourage knowledge sharing within the team by organizing internal workshops and training sessions. Provide technical leadership in Agile development cycles, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and retrospectives. Drive team engagement by implementing developer empowerment initiatives such as rotation of leadership roles within projects.. Integration Development and Technical Oversight Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of secure, scalable, and high-performance integration solutions for global payroll and HR systems. Define best practices for API development, data transformation, and integration workflows, ensuring seamless connectivity across platforms. Guide the team in developing integrations using various file formats (JSON, XML, CSV, EDI) and communication protocols (REST, SOAP, SFTP, Webhooks). Implement and enforce authentication and security standards (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML) for protecting sensitive payroll and HR data. Ensure compliance with global payroll regulatory requirements such as SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, and country-specific payroll tax laws. Develop integration patterns that support real-time payroll data processing, reporting, and audit trails. Work closely with DevOps teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines for integration deployment. Standardize error-handling mechanisms and build self-healing integrations that detect and recover from failures automatically. Oversee integration performance tuning, reducing latency, and optimizing resource utilization for large-scale payroll transactions. Ensure that integration solutions are compatible with multi-tenant SaaS architectures, supporting global clients in different regions. Error Monitoring and Continuous Improvement Establish a proactive monitoring system for real-time tracking of integration performance, failures, and anomalies. Implement robust logging and alerting mechanisms using tools like ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) or Splunk to minimize downtime. Set up automated rollback strategies to ensure minimal disruption in case of integration failures. Work closely with the Customer Support and Payroll Operations teams to resolve integration-related incidents efficiently. Define key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure error rates, uptime, and data synchronization accuracy. Drive root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring integration failures and develop corrective action plans. Implement predictive analytics models to anticipate integration bottlenecks and proactively improve performance. Collaboration and Stakeholder Communication Act as the primary technical liaison between internal teams, payroll SaaS clients, and third-party vendors. Work closely with payroll specialists, compliance teams, and product managers to ensure integrations align with global payroll regulations and customer needs. Collaborate with external HCM, ERP, and financial system providers to build and maintain bi-directional payroll integrations. Participate in client onboarding and implementation processes, ensuring integration capabilities meet their payroll processing requirements. Provide technical guidance and best practices to clients and partners, helping them build and optimize integrations with Mercans’ SaaS platform. Communicate effectively with business leaders, executive stakeholders, and engineering teams to drive alignment on integration strategy. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration with product development, security, and compliance teams to ensure integration designs align with security and regulatory standards. Contribute to client-facing documentation and best practice guides to improve adoption of Mercans’ integration solutions. Strategic Planning and Process Optimization Define and execute a long-term integration strategy that aligns with Mercans’ global payroll SaaS roadmap. Identify opportunities to automate payroll data processing workflows using AI/ML and RPA (Robotic Process Automation). Improve the epic kick-off process, ensuring developers participate in technical feasibility assessments before implementation. Establish and track integration SLAs (Service Level Agreements) with internal teams and external partners. Drive process standardization by defining best practices for integration lifecycle management, from design to deployment and maintenance. Research and evaluate emerging integration technologies, such as event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ), serverless computing, and low-code iPaaS solutions (MuleSoft, Workato, Dell Boomi). Lead efforts to automate deployment processes to reduce manual intervention in integration updates. Drive the adoption of API versioning and microservices architecture to enhance the scalability and maintainability of integrations. Technical Documentation and Knowledge Sharing Oversee the creation and maintenance of comprehensive technical documentation for all integration-related processes. Document the architecture, functionality, and usage of the Dynamic Parser for seamless integration workflows. Develop service interaction diagrams to visually map how different systems and integrations interact within Mercans’ payroll ecosystem. Maintain knowledge repositories such as Confluence, GitHub Wiki, or an internal documentation portal to provide easy access to integration guides. Organize internal training and workshops to improve team knowledge on new technologies, security best practices, and integration techniques. Foster a culture of knowledge sharing, ensuring team members are cross-trained on different integration domains. Mentoring & Developer Growth Establish a structured mentorship program to onboard new integration and full-stack developers. Conduct technical training sessions to enhance team skills in API development, security, and cloud-based integration strategies. Implement code review processes that emphasize best practices, efficiency, and security. Pair new hires with experienced developers, ensuring smooth onboarding and faster productivity. Develop career growth roadmaps for team members, helping them transition into leadership roles over time. Encourage contributions to open-source projects and industry forums to enhance technical expertise. Reduce Gaps Between Estimates & Actual Development Time Improve task estimation accuracy by analyzing historical project data and refining estimation techniques. Implement Agile estimation practices such as story points, t-shirt sizing, and velocity tracking. Conduct post-mortem analyses on past projects to understand estimation discrepancies and improve forecasting. Reduce the gap between estimated vs. actual development time by 20% within the next review period. Reduce Rework & Improve Code Quality Implement best-in-class development practices such as TDD (Test-Driven Development), BDD (Behavior-Driven Development), and code linting. Enforce strict code review policies, ensuring adherence to coding standards and security best practices. Utilize static code analysis tools like SonarQube or CodeClimate to identify and fix vulnerabilities early. Set up automated test pipelines to reduce integration failures before deployment. Reduce reopened and rework tasks by 30%, improving overall development efficiency. Education and experience: 5+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on system integrations. Experience leading or managing a software development team in an Agile environment. Strong proficiency in Java/Kotlin for developing scalable and maintainable integration solutions. 5+ years of experience with iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) solutions such as N8N, MuleSoft, Zapier, and Workato. Experience with RESTful APIs, data transformation, and integration workflows. Understanding of authentication standards such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID, and SAML. Familiarity with database structures (SQL, NoSQL) and cloud-based integration platforms. Exposure to test-driven development and CI/CD pipelines. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze and troubleshoot complex integration challenges. Good verbal and written communication skills in English. Nice to have: Experience in payroll, HR, or workforce management software development. Familiarity with payroll tax regulations and compliance requirements. Experience with iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) solutions such as N8N, MuleSoft, Zapier, Workato, or Zapier. Knowledge of PHP or Python to support additional integration needs.
